# Copilot instructions

This repository is public; commits, pull request descriptions and comments are
public too. Describe code and generic, reusable usage only. Never include
anything specific to a particular machine or deployment: home-directory paths,
`.env` values or which credentials and accounts exist, IP addresses,
reverse-proxy host IDs, switch-over or data-migration commands for a real
server, or details of real user data. The full rules are in `CLAUDE.md`.

Per-layer guidance is in `.github/instructions/`.
